response.original_title: {Official™Guide} How do I upgrade a room on a Silversea  Cruise
response.overview: You can upgrade your suite on a Silversea cruise  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US) * by submitting an offer through the Silversea Upgrade bid-based program, paying the fare difference directly through Silversea or your travel advisor, or watching for occasional complimentary or promotional upgrades + 1 -888-512-8367|(US) *.  1. Bid Through the Silversea Upgrade Program  • Submit an offer: + 1 -888-512-8367|(US) * Eligible guests can access the Silversea Upgrade portal using their booking details to review available categories and place bids, with full rules available in the Frequently + 1 -888-512-8367|(US) * Asked Questions (FAQs). Bids cover the entire voyage per suite, and you can bid on multiple categories without paying unless one is selected.
